# B"H — 06 — Execution Plan

## Phase order (strict — each phase gates the next)

### P0 — Boot repair (GATE: /heichelos/ikar renders)
1. Read critical-boot.js, ikar-stable.js, ikar-first.js in FULL.
2. Trace every consumer of their exports.
3. Rewrite complete files: `bootIkarFirst` a function through the chain,
   `semantic` in the document before first-light.
4. Tabs, no minify, ~120-line modules, read-after-write.
5. Restart `node index` on 8080 (NO watcher — never verify without a restart).
6. Verify: `#heichel-boot-title` + discovery list painted from the semantic
   model; title from the API payload, never a literal.
- NOTHING below starts until P0 passes. This is the mission gate.

### P1 — Heichel root + AMAZING listing layer (first-class track, 02)
- Root hydration from GET /api/social/heichelos/ikar (no description field —
  elegant quiet, never fabrication).
- Series listing: rich discovery cards (DB titles, counts, recency signals,
  progress where data exists, featured paths). "Not basic" bar enforced.
- Sub-series navigation: parent → sub-series → posts, breadcrumbs, contextual
  movement, beautiful at 390/430.
- Post listings: meaningful ordering, metadata hierarchy, continue-reading /
  recently-visited signals.
- Search/filter at listing level where useful.
- Truthful loading/empty/error states at EVERY level; staggered entrances,
  tactile press, route continuity.
- Palace metaphor throughout: arrival with weight, halls → chambers → scrolls,
  depth and light, living palace, procession, metaphor test.

### P2 — Reader (03)
- Auto-scroll contract lock-in: Start=immediate continuous motion, Stop=stop
  and stay, no countdown, no phantom stops, REAL vessel measured.
- Interval measurement proven in a real post vessel (real browser).
- Scribe's Lens default hierarchy proof at 390 and 430.
- NEW regression test files (none exist); full `test:*` list, headless node.

### P3 — Social (04)
- Composer de-duplication proof (idempotency key, single-flight, new tests).
- Hub route-by-route: profiles, search, notifications — each with arrival,
  real data, truthful empties, one-tap Home, motion language.

### P4 — Design-system sweep (05, breadth track)
- Whole-site chrome under shared tokens; CSS classification
  ACTIVE/COMPATIBILITY/DORMANT/LEGACY/DEAD; kill `!important` wars by scoping;
  social stays under `.awtsmoos-social-root`.
- Global top nav: persistent, one-tap Home from EVERY route (gating check),
  safe-area + 44px targets.
- Vivid-extreme-professional pass: bold heroes, midnight/cyan/violet/gold
  with intent; timid/washed-out treated as defect.

### P5 — Verification matrix (07)
- Real-browser pass on every route; 390/430/desktop; RTL; reduced-motion;
  keyboard-only. Embarrassment walk + metaphor test + takeover tests.

### P6 — Clean release (gates, then ship)
1. Fresh isolated worktree from origin/main — NEVER the dirty shared tree.
2. Exact file set; full `test:*` green; review gates.
3. Commit; fast-forward push ONLY (no force, no merge commits).
4. READ `scripts/bhRelease.mjs` FIRST, then `npm run bh` on the remote SSH host.
5. Verify PUBLIC production in a real browser + public SHA verification.

## Standing rules for every worker, every phase

- Read before writing; rewrite complete files; tabs; no minify; ~120-line
  modules; read-after-write; preserve public contracts or trace consumers.
- Restart the server after every change (no watcher).
- Embarrassment + takeover tests run CONTINUOUSLY — not a final phase.
- Tunnel 409/502s are transient: wait 15s, refresh route, retry up to 4x;
  BLOCKED only if down > 5 min.
- Never hard-code DB-backed names/titles in presentation; never fabricate
  data for cards; truthful elegant empty states.
